definitions.explanation: A period during which a war is being fought. Often used as a modifier ({戦時|せんじ}の/{戦時|せんじ}{中|ちゅう}の) to describe conditions, laws, or situations during war.

examples.japanese: {戦時|せんじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しかった→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
{戦時|せんじ}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Food was scarce during the war.

examples.japanese: {戦時|せんじ}⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Under the wartime regime, the freedoms of citizens were severely restricted.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used as a modifier before nouns: {戦時|せんじ}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (during wartime), {戦時|せんじ}⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧ (wartime regime), {戦時|せんじ}{下|か} (under wartime conditions). Contrasts with ⟦{平時|へいじ}→平時：19771_heiji⟧ (peacetime).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戦時|せんじ}{中|ちゅう}: during wartime
- {戦時|せんじ}⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧: wartime regime/system
- {戦時|せんじ}{下|か}: under wartime conditions
- {戦時|せんじ}{国際法|こくさいほう}: laws of war

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{平時|へいじ}→平時：19771_heiji⟧: peacetime (antonym)
- ⟦{戦乱|せんらん}→戦乱：13277_senran⟧: war and turmoil (emphasizes chaos)
